cs.t: Nokia still make phones. They even had a line of smartphones until last year. I've got an XR20 "rugged" phone that's served me well for a few years.
cs.th: All phones sold in the EU to have replaceable batteries from 2027

cs.t: That sounds like it'll still be too big. When it comes to phone screens nowadays, it is the width, not the height, which is the problem. It's physically impossible for me to use my phone (Nokia XR20) one handed, as my thumb isn't long enough to reach the far edge of the screen. So if the new iPhone is getting wider, odds are it'll be too big to fit in the hand even if the height is similar to the iPhone 4.
